name: New Zealand

nationalGame.name: Rugby
nationalGame.about: Rugby is the nation's heart — the All Blacks are the most successful team in rugby history.
nationalGame.note: New Zealand has no official national sport — rugby is what everyone plays and watches.

loved.name: Rugby
loved.why: The whole country stops for All Blacks matches.

loved.name: Netball
loved.why: The most played women's sport in the country.

loved.name: Sailing
loved.why: Kiwi sailors have won the famous America's Cup again and again.

fact: The haka — a Māori challenge dance — is performed by the All Blacks before every international match.
